info.title: Deck of Cards Universal API
info.description: Use the public Deck of Cards API to create, shuffle, draw from, and manage card decks and piles.

put.description: Adds cards to a pile in Deck of Cards.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

deck_id.description: Deck identifier returned by a create deck action.

pile_name.description: Pile name to create or update, such as discard or player1.

cards.description: Comma-separated card codes to add to the pile, such as AS,2S.

piles.description: Pile state keyed by pile name.

remaining.description: Cards remaining in the main deck.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
